$schema_note: Public-safe section templates for Mu$e's Book. No tickers, prices, or levels here — only layout: section order, data type, caps, and the display rules settled in chat 2026-11-10. Layout changes ship as commits to this file. v2 adds the SPY third series, the Mu$e identity label, the four color rules, and the two-decimal money rule settled after v1.

display_rules.colors: One job per color. Identity — Mu$e green, QQQ gray, SPY steel-blue — only on chart lines, legend swatches, and the dot beside a series label. Direction — bars and change values green up / red down. Risk — red exit/danger tick, amber paused, green safe zone on gauges. Neutral captions gray.
display_rules.comparison: Three series — Mu$e (the account), QQQ (the benchmark), SPY (S&P 500 context, via SPY). QQQ stays the benchmark: gap, band color, and headline are vs QQQ only. SPY is context, in its own color, dashed on the race chart.
display_rules.distance_captions: Attached to the tick they belong to, one neutral color on every card. No arrows. Paused state is shown by pill + tick label + card border, never by caption color.
display_rules.identity_labels: The account series is labeled 'Mu$e', never 'Us'.
display_rules.label_layout: Labels get a two-line zone above the gauge track; the track sits below it so a long label can never be eaten by the bar. Gauge box 76px after the 2026-11-10 shrink (was 96px).
display_rules.labels: Price-first, phrased as decisions: 'Bought $X', 'Sell at $X', 'Sell half $X', 'Break even $X'. Never accounting nouns ('paid', 'cost basis') as labels.
display_rules.money: Every dollar amount renders with exactly two decimals ($15.50, $2,000.00) — never one decimal, never three. Shorthand like $30M / $2B is left as-is.
display_rules.options: Two gauges: a stock gauge (price vs breakeven, plus the stock re-eval line) and a contract gauge (premium now vs the -50% premium exit vs the premium-double take-profit). The contract gauge carries the option's real sell line.
display_rules.sort: At-risk positions sort by distance to the primary exit, closest first. Equity: stop. Option: premium exit.

page.height_note: Recompute from the Dev Blueprint before quoting a total: 1,976px at v1, 1,916px after the gauge shrink, before the SPY rows were added.
page.rule: Sections render in the order listed. Each section stops growing at its cap, so total page length is deterministic no matter how much data the generator emits.
